description: Push notification templates for Calm Quest — daily reminders, streak celebrations, and gentle nudges

templates.title: Daily Inspiration Ready
templates.body: Your daily affirmation is waiting. 🌿 Take a moment to read, breathe, and begin your day with intention.

templates.title: Time to Breathe
templates.body: Three deep breaths can change your whole state. 🫁 Let's take a minute together — you deserve this pause.

templates.title: Wind Down
templates.body: The day is fading. 🎵 Let a calming soundscape carry you into the evening. Pick one and let go.

templates.title: Streak Alert — 🔥 3 Days!
templates.body: Three days of calm in a row! You're building a beautiful habit. Come back today to keep the streak alive.

templates.title: Streak Alert — 🔥 7 Days!
templates.body: One full week of Calm Quest! That's 7 days of showing up for yourself. Celebrate this moment — you've earned it.

templates.title: We Miss You
templates.body: It's been a few days. 🌱 However you're feeling, there's no judgment here — just a gentle invitation to come back and take a moment for yourself.

templates.title: Try Premium Free
templates.body: Unlock everything Calm Quest has to offer — all soundscapes, unlimited games, no ads. Start your 7-day free trial today. ✨

notes: All notification bodies should feel like a gentle tap on the shoulder, not a loud alarm. Use emojis sparingly and meaningfully. Never guilt-trip the user.
